meta.purpose: AI semantic-recall benchmark. Every text below has ZERO lexical retrieval hits in the offline core; a correct verdict is reachable only when the LLM nominates a real corpus card asserting the same proposition. Expected verdicts are derived from the recalled card's own stored stance, never from the AI.
meta.construction: Mechanism-coverage set, not a random sample. Selected by probing candidate low-overlap restatements and keeping only those with verified rule-zero-recall and a real same-proposition card in the corpus. Cases where recall finds only a low-weight background card are kept as negative controls (expected undetermined).
meta.pass_condition: A case scores correct only when the verdict equals the expected verdict AND every citation is a real corpus card whose stance equals that card's stored stance AND, where expect_card is set, that specific card is cited. Negative controls DP16/DP17 expect undetermined: AI must recall the weak background card yet still refuse because its stored weight is below threshold.
meta.note: Do not read these numbers as real-world fact-checking accuracy. This set isolates one mechanism: does AI recall change a measured number while staying gated?
